name: Adnan Baig

projects.title: Robot Operator HMI
projects.description: React and TypeScript app that drives all operation and control of a wearable humanoid suit, including readiness checks, operator workflows, system status, and accessible audio controls.

projects.title: Fleet Operations Dashboard
projects.description: Production dashboard connecting robot inventory, heartbeats, build telemetry, collection episodes, Jira repairs, and technician workloads.

projects.title: Humanoid Robot Development
projects.description: Piloted humanoid robots with teleoperation, Foxglove, and Manus to collect AI training data, monitor actuator health and runtime faults, and label datasets with engineering teams.

engineeringProjects.title: SO-101 Robotics Workstation
engineeringProjects.description: In progress: leader-follower teleoperation, RealSense capture, LeRobot dataset and training pipelines, and MuJoCo simulation. A fail-closed control plane includes exclusive motor-bus ownership, watchdog supervision, and a latched emergency stop.

engineeringProjects.title: Blockchain Certificate System DApp
engineeringProjects.description: Decentralized application for verifiable academic credentials — Solidity smart contracts handle on-chain issuance and revocation, IPFS stores document hashes, and a React frontend provides trustless verification without a central authority.

engineeringProjects.title: Wildfire Risk Assessment Model
engineeringProjects.description: U-Net CNN trained on 12-band Sentinel-2 satellite imagery to identify wildfire-risk zones, with augmentation, dropout, and validation against Cal Fire ground truth. Second place at the ACM AI Hackathon.

engineeringProjects.title: SentrySight
engineeringProjects.description: AI firearm-detection project combining computer vision with an interactive web interface for exploring detections and alerts.

aboutpara: Robotics software engineer at Meta Reality Labs through Sigma Design, building operator interfaces, fleet tooling, and hardware-software integrations. I work across React and TypeScript frontends, Python services, Embedded Linux, NVIDIA Jetson systems, EtherCAT networks, and camera pipelines. Previously, I piloted humanoid robots at Figure AI and worked in cybersecurity at Cyber Proud / CalSTRS. I earned my B.S. in Computer Science from Sacramento State in May 2025. Outside work, I am developing an SO-101 robotics workstation.
